title: Plastering alongside Johnny St. Cyr
summary: He and St. Cyr worked plastering jobs together, and Russell stayed with St. Cyr in California.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Oh, boy, that's your car. I noticed here on your car, you say you do plastering, and you used to, did you ever work with Johnny St. Cyr on the same jobs?
Oh, yeah. Him and I worked on the same jobs together.

We plastered together and we played music together. Yeah. Uh-huh. Because I last saw him in California and he was doing plastering then. I spoke to him in California last year. Oh, you were out there. Yeah, on Wall Street.
He lived out there. Oh, yeah.
He still out. I stayed at his house, Professor Minetta and I, about a month. Yeah, we stayed there.
Well, I lived there's about six squares from him. Oh, really? But I never could get to see him. And I left before I saw him, but I really wanted to see him because-
He's awfully busy, I guess. He was a good friend of mine.
Yeah, he used to go to work at one o'clock. Yeah. And that's the time I'd be waking, you see.
